CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financial_core.can_manage_finances(p_group_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.memberships m
      WHERE m.group_id = p_group_id
        AND m.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
        AND m.membership_status = 'active'
    )
    AND public.has_group_permission(
      p_group_id, 'finances.manage', (SELECT auth.uid()));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financial_core.check_f3_posting_closure()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM public.financial_postings p WHERE p.event_id = NEW.event_id) <> 2
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.financial_events e WHERE e.id = NEW.event_id
      AND e.economic_payload_fingerprint = financial_core.f3_fingerprint(NEW.canonical_payload))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'POSTING_SET_INCOMPLETE'; END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

routines.name: currency_scale
routines.functiondef:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financial_core.currency_scale(p_currency text)
 RETURNS smallint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE upper(p_currency)
    WHEN 'XAF' THEN 0 WHEN 'XOF' THEN 0 WHEN 'TZS' THEN 0
    WHEN 'UGX' THEN 0 WHEN 'RWF' THEN 0
    WHEN 'NGN' THEN 2 WHEN 'GHS' THEN 2 WHEN 'KES' THEN 2
    WHEN 'ZAR' THEN 2 WHEN 'ETB' THEN 2 WHEN 'CDF' THEN 2
    WHEN 'USD' THEN 2 WHEN 'EUR' THEN 2 WHEN 'GBP' THEN 2
    WHEN 'CAD' THEN 2 WHEN 'CHF' THEN 2 WHEN 'AUD' THEN 2
    WHEN 'AED' THEN 2
    ELSE NULL
  END;
$function$

routines.name: f3_amount
f3_canonical
routines.functiondef:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financial_core.f3_canonical(p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_result text; v_keys constant text[] := ARRAY[
  'contract_version','group_id','ledger_epoch_id','event_class','effect_kind','currency',
  'amount','occurred_at','source_module','source_record_id','request_id','account_id',
  'destination_account_id','fund_id','category_id','member_id','project_id','opening_provenance_id'];
BEGIN
  IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR NOT (p_payload ?& v_keys)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OCCURRENCE_INTEGRITY'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_each(p_payload) AS x(key,value)
    WHERE NOT (x.key = ANY(v_keys)) OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(x.value) NOT IN ('string','null'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OCCURRENCE_INTEGRITY'; END IF;
  -- Each value is a normalized ASCII scalar. No jsonb object-text hashing.
  SELECT '{' || pg_catalog.string_agg(pg_catalog.to_json(x.key)::text || ':' || x.value::text,
    ',' ORDER BY x.key COLLATE "C") || '}' INTO v_result
  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_each(p_payload) AS x(key,value);
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

routines.name: f3_currency
routines.functiondef:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financial_core.f3_currency(p_value jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_text text := p_value #>> '{}';
BEGIN
  IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p_value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
    OR pg_catalog.length(v_text) <> 3 OR v_text !~ '^[a-zA-Z]{3}$'
    OR financial_core.currency_scale(v_text) IS NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY'; END IF;
  RETURN pg_catalog.upper(v_text);
END;
$function$

routines.name: f3_fingerprint
routines.functiondef:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financial_core.f3_fingerprint(p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(
    pg_catalog.convert_to(financial_core.f3_canonical(p_payload), 'UTF8')), 'hex');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financial_core.f3_trim(p_text text)

  SELECT pg_catalog.btrim(p_text,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financial_core.guard_f3_posting_closure()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Serializes a privileged late append against completion of the posting command.
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.financial_events e WHERE e.id = NEW.event_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM financial_core.posting_command_payloads c WHERE c.event_id = NEW.event_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'POSTING_SET_CLOSED'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

routines.functiondef:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financial_core.guard_financial_event_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POSTED_FINANCIAL_EVENT_DELETE_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.id, NEW.group_id, NEW.ledger_epoch_id, NEW.currency, NEW.event_class,
      NEW.source_module, NEW.source_record_id, NEW.effect_kind, NEW.request_id,
      NEW.economic_payload_fingerprint, NEW.occurred_at, NEW.posted_at,
      NEW.created_at, NEW.created_by, NEW.description, NEW.reference_metadata,
      NEW.reversal_of_event_id)
     IS DISTINCT FROM
     (OLD.id, OLD.group_id, OLD.ledger_epoch_id, OLD.currency, OLD.event_class,
      OLD.source_module, OLD.source_record_id, OLD.effect_kind, OLD.request_id,
      OLD.economic_payload_fingerprint, OLD.occurred_at, OLD.posted_at,
      OLD.created_at, OLD.created_by, OLD.description, OLD.reference_metadata,
      OLD.reversal_of_event_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'POSTED_FINANCIAL_EVENT_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.status = OLD.status THEN
    IF (NEW.replacement_event_id, NEW.corrected_at, NEW.correction_reason)
       IS DISTINCT FROM
       (OLD.replacement_event_id, OLD.corrected_at, OLD.correction_reason) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FINANCIAL_CORRECTION_LINKAGE_REQUIRES_STATUS_TRANSITION'
        USING ERRCODE = '55000';
    END IF;
  ELSIF NOT (OLD.status = 'posted' AND NEW.status IN ('corrected', 'reversed')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_FINANCIAL_EVENT_TRANSITION' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

routines.name: lock_f3_identity
routines.functiondef:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financial_core.lock_f3_identity(p_group uuid, p_request uuid, p_module text, p_source text, p_effect text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_group IS NULL OR p_module IS NULL OR p_source IS NULL OR p_effect IS NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FINANCIAL_OCCURRENCE_LOCK_KEY_REQUIRED'; END IF;
  -- Fixed order: manual request, then immutable source. Neither contains epoch.
  IF p_request IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtextextended(
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array('f3-request',p_group,p_request)::text,0));
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtextextended(
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array('f3-source',p_group,p_module,p_source,p_effect)::text,0));
END;
$function$

constraints.name: financial_accounts_group_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES groups(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: financial_accounts_id_group_currency
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (id, group_id, currency)

constraints.name: financial_accounts_lifecycle
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::financial_account_status) AND (inactive_at IS NULL) AND (closed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'inactive'::financial_account_status) AND (inactive_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'closed'::financial_account_status) AND (inactive_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: financial_accounts_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) <= 120)))

constraints.name: financial_accounts_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: financial_categories_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: financial_categories_group_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES groups(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: financial_categories_id_group_class
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (id, group_id, category_class)

constraints.name: financial_categories_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) <= 120)))

constraints.name: financial_categories_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: financial_events_balance_guard
constraints.definition: TRIGGER DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: financial_events_correction_state
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'posted'::financial_event_status) AND (corrected_at IS NULL) AND (replacement_event_id IS NULL) AND (correction_reason IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'corrected'::financial_event_status) AND (corrected_at IS NOT NULL) AND (replacement_event_id IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM correction_reason)) >= 3)) OR ((status = 'reversed'::financial_event_status) AND (corrected_at IS NOT NULL) AND (replacement_event_id IS NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM correction_reason)) >= 3))))

constraints.name: financial_events_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: financial_events_currency_supported
constraints.definition: CHECK (((currency = upper(currency)) AND (financial_core.currency_scale(currency) IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: financial_events_economic_payload_fingerprint_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((economic_payload_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))

constraints.name: financial_events_effect_kind_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((effect_kind ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$'::text))

constraints.name: financial_events_epoch_scope
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (ledger_epoch_id, group_id, currency) REFERENCES financial_ledger_epochs(id, group_id, currency) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: financial_events_group_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES groups(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: financial_events_id_group
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (id, group_id)

constraints.name: financial_events_not_self_linked
constraints.definition: CHECK (((reversal_of_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM id) AND (replacement_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM id)))

constraints.name: financial_events_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: financial_events_posting_scope
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (id, group_id, ledger_epoch_id, currency, occurred_at)

constraints.name: financial_events_reference_metadata_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(reference_metadata) = 'object'::text))

constraints.name: financial_events_replacement_scope
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (replacement_event_id, group_id) REFERENCES financial_events(id, group_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: financial_events_reversal_scope
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (reversal_of_event_id, group_id) REFERENCES financial_events(id, group_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: financial_events_source_identity
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (group_id, source_module, source_record_id, effect_kind, ledger_epoch_id)

constraints.name: financial_events_source_module_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((source_module ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$'::text))

constraints.name: financial_events_source_record_id_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((length(source_record_id) >= 1) AND (length(source_record_id) <= 256)) AND (source_record_id = TRIM(BOTH FROM source_record_id))))

constraints.name: financial_funds_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: financial_funds_default_general
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT is_default) OR ((NOT is_restricted) AND (status = 'active'::financial_config_status))))

constraints.name: financial_funds_group_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES groups(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) <= 120)))

constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: financial_ledger_epoch_no_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (group_id WITH =, tstzrange(effective_from, COALESCE(effective_to, 'infinity'::timestamp with time zone), '[)'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.name: financial_ledger_epoch_range
constraints.definition: CHECK (((effective_to IS NULL) OR (effective_to > effective_from)))

constraints.name: financial_ledger_epoch_scope
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (id, group_id, currency)

constraints.name: financial_ledger_epochs_approval_note_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM approval_note)) >= 3))

constraints.name: financial_ledger_epochs_approved_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (approved_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: financial_ledger_epochs_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: financial_ledger_epochs_currency_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM currency)) >= 3) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM currency)) <= 8)))

constraints.name: financial_ledger_epochs_group_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES groups(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: financial_ledger_epochs_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: financial_ledger_epochs_source_kind_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((source_kind = ANY (ARRAY['migration_backfill'::text, 'currency_transition'::text, 'legacy_resolution'::text, 'cutover'::text])))

constraints.name: financial_postings_account_scope
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id, group_id, currency) REFERENCES financial_accounts(id, group_id, currency) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: financial_postings_amount_nonzero
constraints.definition: CHECK ((amount_signed <> (0)::numeric))

constraints.name: financial_postings_amount_precision
constraints.definition: CHECK (((financial_core.currency_scale(currency) IS NOT NULL) AND (amount_signed = round(amount_signed, (financial_core.currency_scale(currency))::integer))))

constraints.name: financial_postings_balance_guard
constraints.definition: TRIGGER DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: financial_postings_category_scope
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (category_id, group_id, category_class) REFERENCES financial_categories(id, group_id, category_class) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: financial_postings_category_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((control_class = 'income'::financial_control_class) AND (category_id IS NOT NULL) AND (category_class IS NOT NULL) AND (category_class = 'income'::financial_category_class)) OR ((control_class = 'expense'::financial_control_class) AND (category_id IS NOT NULL) AND (category_class IS NOT NULL) AND (category_class = 'expense'::financial_category_class)) OR ((control_class <> ALL (ARRAY['income'::financial_control_class, 'expense'::financial_control_class])) AND (category_id IS NULL) AND (category_class IS NULL))))

constraints.name: financial_postings_custody_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((control_class = 'custody'::financial_control_class) AND (account_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((control_class <> 'custody'::financial_control_class) AND (account_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: financial_postings_event_scope
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id, group_id, ledger_epoch_id, currency, occurred_at) REFERENCES financial_events(id, group_id, ledger_epoch_id, currency, occurred_at) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: financial_postings_fund_scope
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (fund_id, group_id) REFERENCES financial_funds(id, group_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: financial_postings_member_scope
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (member_id, group_id) REFERENCES memberships(id, group_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: financial_postings_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: financial_postings_project_scope
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (project_id, group_id) REFERENCES projects(id, group_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
